greek: Τοῦ δὲ μηνὸς τοῦ τρίτου τῆς ἐξόδου τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ ἤλθοσαν εἰς τὴν ἔρημον τοῦ Σινα.
hint: In the third month after leaving Egypt, on that very day, the sons of Israel reach the wilderness of Sinai.

notes.text: Of the month, the third, the article repeated over the numeral; μήν, a month, one translation, plain text.
ἔξοδος, a going out, the noun the book's Greek title is drawn from.

reading: [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[of the month|of the month, of the crescent, of the nimbus, of the glory|μήν]] [[of the third|of the third, of the third and finishing, of the day after to-morrow, of the day before, of the thirdly, of the sacrifice to the dead offered the third day after the funeral, of the third part|τρίτος]] [[of the going out|of the going out, of the marching out and military expedition, of the solemn procession, of the way out and outlet, of the end, of the issue, of the departure and death, of the end of a tragedy, of the music played at its close|ἔξοδος]] of the sons of [[name:Ισραηλ]] [[out of|out of, forth from, from|ἐκ]] [[of earth|of earth, of land, of ground|γῆ]] of [[name:Αἰγύπτου]] [[to the day|to the day, to the day-break, to the time|ἡμέρα]] [[to this|to this, to the nearer, to what follows|οὗτος]] [[came|came, went, went back and returned, were going to and intended, came within a little of and were near|ἔρχομαι]] [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] [[the desert part|the desert part, the desolate and lone and lonely and lonesome and solitary, the desolate and helpless, the reft of and void, the destitute of, the wanting and without, the undefended|ἔρημος]] of the [[name:Σινα]].

names.gloss: (Ισραηλ, from Hebrew Yiśrāʾēl, which the Hebrew of Genesis 32:29 hears in śārâ ʿim ʾĕlōhîm, "he strove with God")
(Αἴγυπτος, the Greek name of the land; Hebrew Miṣrayim)
(Σινα, from Hebrew Sînay, of uncertain meaning)

greek: καὶ ἐξῆραν ἐκ Ραφιδιν καὶ ἤλθοσαν εἰς τὴν ἔρημον τοῦ Σινα, καὶ παρενέβαλεν ἐκεῖ Ισραηλ κατέναντι τοῦ ὄρους.
hint: They set out from Rephidim, come into the wilderness of Sinai, and Israel camps there facing the mountain.

notes.text: ἐξαίρω, to lift up, the verb the Greek uses for breaking camp, for the Hebrew wayyisʿû.
The singular verb with Israel as its subject, after the plurals before it.

reading: and [[lifted up|lifted up and lifted off the earth, raised in dignity and exalted, raised and aroused and stirred up, carried off for himself and earned and won and gained, took on himself|ἐξαίρω]] [[out of|out of, forth from, from|ἐκ]] of [[name:Ραφιδιν]] and [[came|came, went, went back and returned, were going to and intended, came within a little of and were near|ἔρχομαι]] [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] [[the desert part|the desert part, the desolate and lone and lonely and lonesome and solitary, the desolate and helpless, the reft of and void, the destitute of, the wanting and without, the undefended|ἔρημος]] of the [[name:Σινα]], and [[put in beside|put in beside and inserted and interpolated and interposed, insinuated, put in line with, fell into line and encamped|παρεμβάλλω]] [[there|there, in that place|ἐκεῖ]] [[name:Ισραηλ]] [[over against|over against and opposite and before|κατέναντι]] [[of the mountain|of the mountain and hill|ὄρος]].

names.gloss: (Ραφιδιν, from Hebrew Rĕpîdîm, of uncertain meaning)

greek: καὶ Μωυσῆς ἀνέβη εἰς τὸ ὄρος τοῦ θεοῦ· καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτὸν ὁ θεὸς ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους λέγων Τάδε ἐρεῖς τῷ οἴκῳ Ιακωβ καὶ ἀναγγελεῖς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ
hint: Moses goes up the mountain of God, and God calls to him from it with a message for the house of Jacob.

notes.text: Into the mountain of God: the Hebrew has ʾel-hāʾĕlōhîm, to God; the Greek names the mountain.
God called him: the Hebrew has YHWH, the lord, as the caller.

reading: and [[name:Μωυσῆς]] [[went up|went up, mounted, ascended, went up to, rose, came up, came to and arrived at, went up country, went aboard|ἀναβαίνω]] [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] [[the mountain|the mountain and hill|ὄρος]] [[of the God|of him who is God definitively, of the one the article marks out, of the known and the only|θεός]]; and [[called|called, summoned, called to himself, invited|καλέω]] him [[the God|he who is God definitively, the one the article marks out, the known and the only|θεός]] [[out of|out of, forth from, from|ἐκ]] [[of the mountain|of the mountain and hill|ὄρος]] [[saying|saying, speaking, declaring, calling by name, telling|λέγω]] [[these|these, the immediate present, here and on the spot, thus, hither and to this spot, therefore and on this account|ὅδε]] [[you will say|you will say, you will speak, you will declare, you will call by name, you will tell|λέγω]] [[to the house|to the house and abode and dwelling, to the room and chamber, to the house of a god and temple, to the household goods and substance, to the household and family|οἶκος]] of [[name:Ιακωβ]] and [[you will carry back tidings of|you will carry back tidings of / report|ἀναγγέλλω]] to the sons of [[name:Ισραηλ]]

names.gloss: (Μωυσῆς, from Hebrew Mōšeh, which the Hebrew of 2:10 hears in māšâ, "to draw out")
(Ιακωβ, from Hebrew Yaʿăqōb, which the Hebrew of Genesis 25:26 hears in ʿāqēb, "heel")

greek: Αὐτοὶ ἑωράκατε ὅσα πεποίηκα τοῖς Αἰγυπτίοις, καὶ ἀνέλαβον ὑμᾶς ὡσεὶ ἐπὶ πτερύγων ἀετῶν καὶ προσηγαγόμην ὑμᾶς πρὸς ἐμαυτόν.
hint: God recalls what was done to Egypt, and how he bore Israel up as on eagles' wings and brought them to himself.

notes.text: You yourselves have seen, αὐτοί emphatic with the second person, the perfect a standing state.
First person singular, I took up; the form is also the third plural, which the sentence does not allow.
προσάγω in the middle, to bring to oneself: Middle Liddell's middle opens with to bring, and draw to oneself, attach to oneself.

reading: yourselves [[you have seen|you have seen and it stands so, you have perceived and it stands so, you have beheld and it stands so, you have looked at and it stands so|ὁράω]] [[as great as|as great as, as much as, as far as, as long as, as many as|ὅσος]] [[I have made|I have made and it stands made, I have done and it stands done, I have produced and it stands produced, I have created and it stands created|ποιέω]] to the [[name:Αἰγυπτίοις]], and [[I took up|I took up, I took into one's hands, I took on board ship, I took with one, I took upon myself and assumed, I learned by rote, I got back and regained and recovered, I retrieved and made good, I restored and repaired and regained strength and revived, I took up again and resumed and recollected, I pulled short up and checked and called back, I gained quite over and won over|ἀναλαμβάνω]] you [[just as if|just as if and as though, about|ὡσεί]] [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + genitive]] [[of wings|of wings, of winged creatures and birds, of anything like a wing and flaps, of skirts, of broad edges, of anything that covers and protects, of flights, of flows|πτέρυξ]] [[of eagles|of eagles, of eagles as standards, of pediments|ἀετός]] and [[I brought|I brought, I drew to myself and attached to myself and brought over to my side, I drew all eyes upon myself, I drew to myself and embraced, I induced, I took to myself and took up, I procured and imported|προσάγω]] you [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] myself.

greek: καὶ νῦν ἐὰν ἀκοῇ ἀκούσητε τῆς ἐμῆς φωνῆς καὶ φυλάξητε τὴν διαθήκην μου, ἔσεσθέ μοι λαὸς περιούσιος ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν· ἐμὴ γάρ ἐστιν πᾶσα ἡ γῆ·
hint: If they hear and keep the disposition he names, they will be his own people out of all nations, since all the earth is his.

notes.text: With hearing you may hear, the noun with its own verb, for the Hebrew infinitive absolute šāmôaʿ tišmĕʿû.
Having more than enough, especial, peculiar, for the Hebrew sĕgullâ, a treasured possession.
Of my voice: ἀκούω with the genitive, the possessive between the article and the noun.

reading: and [[now at this very time|now at this very time, now, of the present, the present time, just now and but now, as it is and as the case now stands, in this case|νῦν]] [[if haply|if haply, if|ἐάν]] [[to a hearing|to a hearing and sound heard, to thing heard and hearsay and report and news and tidings, by hearsay, to sense of hearing, to act of hearing and hearing, to ear|ἀκοή]] [[you may hear|you may hear, you may have hearing of, you may hear tell of, you may know by hearsay, you may hearken and give ear, you may listen to and obey|ἀκούω]] [[of the mine|of the mine, of the to me and relating to me and against me, of the by me|ἐμός]] [[of sound|of sound and tone, of sound of the voice, of cry, of faculty of speech and discourse, of language, of saying|φωνή]] and [[you may keep watch and ward|you may keep watch and ward and keep guard, you may watch and guard and keep and defend, you may watch for and lie in wait for, you may keep and maintain and cherish, you may observe|φυλάσσω]] [[the disposition|the disposition of property by will, the will and testament, the arrangement between two parties, the covenant|διαθήκη]] of me, you will be to me [[a people|a people, men, soldiers, a land-army, the common men, folk, Jews, Christians|λαός]] [[having more than enough|having more than enough and especial and peculiar|περιούσιος]] [[from|from, away from, far from, apart from|ἀπό]] [[of all|of all, of the whole, of every, of every single|πᾶς]] [[of the numbers of people accustomed to live together|of the numbers of people accustomed to live together and companies and bodies of men, of the hosts, of the swarms and flocks, of the nations and peoples, of the nations and gentiles, of the special classes, of the castes and tribes, of the sexes|ἔθνος]]; [[mine|mine, to me and relating to me and against me, by me|ἐμός]] [[for|for, since and as, for otherwise and else, now, but, why and what, would that|γάρ]], is [[all|all, the whole, every, every single|πᾶς]] [[the earth|the earth, the land, the ground|γῆ]];

greek: ὑμεῖς δὲ ἔσεσθέ μοι βασίλειον ἱεράτευμα καὶ ἔθνος ἅγιον. ταῦτα τὰ ῥήματα ἐρεῖς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ.
hint: Israel is called a holy nation and a priesthood with βασίλειον, kingly or a kingdom; Moses is to pass these words on.

notes.text: The Hebrew has mamleket kōhănîm, a kingdom of priests, a noun in construct. βασίλειον is read here as the adjective, kingly, with ἱεράτευμα; it is also the neuter noun, a palace or kingdom, which would make two nouns side by side. The form allows both.
ἱεράτευμα, a priesthood, one translation, plain text.

reading: you [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], will be to me [[of the king|of the king and kingly and royal|βασίλειος]] a priesthood and [[a number of people accustomed to live together|a number of people accustomed to live together and company and body of men, a host, swarms and flocks, a nation and people, the nations and gentiles, a special class, a caste and tribe, a sex|ἔθνος]] [[devoted to the gods|devoted to the gods and sacred and holy, holy and pure|ἅγιος]]. [[these|these, the nearer, what follows|οὗτος]] [[the things which are said|the things which are said and spoken, the words, the sayings, the phrases, the subjects of speech and things, the verbs|ῥῆμα]] [[you will say|you will say, you will speak, you will declare, you will call by name, you will tell|λέγω]] to the sons of [[name:Ισραηλ]].

greek: ἦλθεν δὲ Μωυσῆς καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ παρέθηκεν αὐτοῖς πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους, οὓς συνέταξεν αὐτῷ ὁ θεός.
hint: Moses comes, summons the elders of the people, and sets before them all the words God commanded.

notes.text: παρατίθημι, to place beside, set before, for the Hebrew wayyāśem lipnêhem.
God commanded him: the Hebrew has YHWH.

greek: ἀπεκρίθη δὲ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὁμοθυμαδὸν καὶ εἶπαν Πάντα, ὅσα εἶπεν ὁ θεός, ποιήσομεν καὶ ἀκουσόμεθα. ἀνήνεγκεν δὲ Μωυσῆς τοὺς λόγους τοῦ λαοῦ πρὸς τὸν θεόν.
hint: All the people answer together that they will do and hear all God has said; Moses carries their words back.

notes.text: We will do and we will hear: the Hebrew has naʿăśeh only, we will do; and hear is not there.
With one accord, one translation, plain text, for the Hebrew yaḥdāw.
Answered in the singular, said in the plural, as the collective λαός allows.

greek: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ παραγίνομαι πρὸς σὲ ἐν στύλῳ νεφέλης, ἵνα ἀκούσῃ ὁ λαὸς λαλοῦντός μου πρὸς σὲ καὶ σοὶ πιστεύσωσιν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα. ἀνήγγειλεν δὲ Μωυσῆς τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ λαοῦ πρὸς κύριον.
hint: The lord will come to Moses in a pillar of cloud so the people hear him speak and trust Moses for ever.

notes.text: In a pillar of cloud: the Hebrew has bĕʿab heʿānān, in the thickness of the cloud.
Me talking, a genitive participle after ἀκούω, as the genitive of the person heard.
And may trust you: the Hebrew has wĕgam-bĕkā, and also in you; the Greek's καί may be either and or also.

greek: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν Καταβὰς διαμάρτυραι τῷ λαῷ καὶ ἅγνισον αὐτοὺς σήμερον καὶ αὔριον, καὶ πλυνάτωσαν τὰ ἱμάτια·
hint: The lord tells Moses to go down, charge the people, purify them for two days, and have them wash their clothes.

notes.text: Having gone down, protest solemnly to the people: the Hebrew has lēk ʾel-hāʿām, go to the people; and for ἅγνισον, qiddaštām, sanctify them.
ἁγνίζω, to cleanse away, purify, hallow; Middle Liddell's first sense heads.
To-day, one translation, plain text.

reading: [[said|said, spoke, declared, called by name, told|λέγω]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[lord|lord / master, the head, master, the Lord, Jehovah|κύριος]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] [[name:Μωυσῆν]] [[having stepped down|having stepped down, having gone and come down, having gone down from, having dismounted, having come down stairs, having gone down from the inland parts to the sea, having come to land and got safe ashore, having gone down into the arena, having come down from the tribune, having come to, having ended|καταβαίνω]] [[protest solemnly|protest solemnly, protest, protest and asseverate, beg earnestly and conjure|διαμαρτύρομαι]] [[to the people|to the people, to the men, to the soldiers, to the land-army, to the common men, to the folk, to the Jews, to the Christians|λαός]] and [[cleanse away|cleanse away, cleanse and purify, hallow|ἁγνίζω]] them to-day and [[to-morrow|to-morrow, on the morrow|αὔριον]], and [[let wash|let wash and clean, let wash off|πλύνω]] [[the outer garments|the outer garments and cloaks, the mantles, the clothes|ἱμάτιον]];

greek: καὶ ἔστωσαν ἕτοιμοι εἰς τὴν ἡμέραν τὴν τρίτην· τῇ γὰρ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ καταβήσεται κύριος ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος τὸ Σινα ἐναντίον παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ.
hint: They are to be ready for the third day, when the lord will come down on the mountain of Sinai before all the people.

notes.text: Let be, the present imperative of εἰμί, third plural.
The mountain, the Sinai: the indeclinable name read in apposition, in the mountain's case, as τῷ ὄρει τῷ Γαλααδ at Genesis 31:23.

reading: and let be [[at hand|at hand and ready and prepared, sure to come and certain, easy to be done and feasible, carried into effect and made good, ready and active and zealous|ἕτοιμος]] [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] [[the day|the day, the day-break, the time|ἡμέρα]] [[the third|the third, the third and finishing, the day after to-morrow, the day before, the thirdly, the sacrifice to the dead offered the third day after the funeral, the third part|τρίτος]]; [[for|for, since and as, for otherwise and else, now, but, why and what, would that|γάρ]], [[to the day|to the day, to the day-break, to the time|ἡμέρα]] [[to the third|to the third, to the third and finishing, to the day after to-morrow, to the day before, to the thirdly, to the sacrifice to the dead offered the third day after the funeral, to the third part|τρίτος]] [[will step down|will step down, will go and come down, will go down from, will dismount, will come down stairs, will go down from the inland parts to the sea, will come to land and get safe ashore, will go down into the arena, will come down from the tribune, will come to, will end|καταβαίνω]] [[lord|lord / master, the head, master, the Lord, Jehovah|κύριος]] [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + accusative]] [[the mountain|the mountain and hill|ὄρος]] the [[name:Σινα]] [[in the presence of|in the presence of and before, opposite and face to face, against|ἐναντίον]] [[of all|of all, of the whole, of every, of every single|πᾶς]] [[of the people|of the people, of the men, of the soldiers, of the land-army, of the common men, of the folk, of the Jews, of the Christians|λαός]].

greek: καὶ ἀφοριεῖς τὸν λαὸν κύκλῳ λέγων Προσέχετε ἑαυτοῖς τοῦ ἀναβῆναι εἰς τὸ ὄρος καὶ θιγεῖν τι αὐτοῦ· πᾶς ὁ ἁψάμενος τοῦ ὄρους θανάτῳ τελευτήσει.
hint: Moses must set bounds round the people: no one may go up or touch the mountain, and whoever touches it dies.

notes.text: You will mark off the people, for the Hebrew wĕhigbaltā ʾet-hāʿām, you shall set bounds for the people.

notes.text: βιάζω, the present middle/passive read in the middle's senses, as Genesis 33:11's aorist middle: to overpower by force, to force one's way.
May destroy from among them: the Hebrew has pen-yiprāṣ-bām, lest he break out against them.

reading: [[said|said, spoke, declared, called by name, told|λέγω]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], to him [[lord|lord / master, the head, master, the Lord, Jehovah|κύριος]] [[go slowly|go slowly and walk, go and march, go by land, enter, proceed|βαδίζω]] [[step down|step down, go and come down, go down from, dismount, come down stairs, go down from the inland parts to the sea, come to land and get safe ashore, go down into the arena, come down from the tribune, come to, end|καταβαίνω]] and [[go up|go up, mount, ascend, go up to, rise, come up, come to and arrive at, go up country, go aboard|ἀναβαίνω]] you and [[name:Ααρων]] [[in the midst of|in the midst of, among, in common, along with, with, by means of|μετά + genitive]] of you; [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[the priests|the priests and sacrificers, the ministers|ἱερεύς]] and [[the people|the people, the men, the soldiers, the land-army, the common men, the folk, the Jews, the Christians|λαός]] [[not|not, that not, perhaps, surely not and you don't mean to say that|μή]] [[let overpower by force|let overpower by force and press hard, let do them violence, let lay violent hands on, let force, let use force and struggle, let force one's way, let increase in violence|βιάζω]] [[to go up|to go up, to mount, to ascend, to go up to, to rise, to come up, to come to and arrive at, to go up country, to go aboard|ἀναβαίνω]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] [[the God|he who is God definitively, the one the article marks out, the known and the only|θεός]], [[that at no time|that at no time and lest ever, never and on no account, perhaps|μήποτε]] [[may destroy utterly|may destroy utterly and kill and slay, may destroy and demolish and waste, may talk and bore to death, may lose utterly|ἀπόλλυμι]] [[from|from, away from, far from, apart from|ἀπό]] of them [[lord|lord / master, the head, master, the Lord, Jehovah|κύριος]].

names.gloss: (Ααρων, from Hebrew ʾAhărōn, of uncertain meaning)

greek: κατέβη δὲ Μωυσῆς πρὸς τὸν λαὸν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς.
hint: Moses goes down to the people and speaks to them.

notes.text: He said to them, with no object: what he said is not given.

reading: [[stepped down|stepped down, went and came down, went down from, dismounted, came down stairs, went down from the inland parts to the sea, came to land and got safe ashore, went down into the arena, came down from the tribune, came to, ended|καταβαίνω]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[name:Μωυσῆς]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] [[the people|the people, the men, the soldiers, the land-army, the common men, the folk, the Jews, the Christians|λαός]] and [[said|said, spoke, declared, called by name, told|λέγω]] to them.
